name: finding-unknowns
description: Surface your unknowns before they get expensive, and keep your judgment when agents hand work back. finding-unknowns: eight discovery techniques plus Cartographer mode (coverage-gated, regret-ordered unknowns ledger with reversibility floor, verification contract, the spec as its default end, and experimental Workflow execution, graph-ordered and approval-gated). keep-the-reasoning: stakes-triaged handoff packets — evidence first, what checks did not prove, what went unchecked, and decisions listed at high stakes. theory-vs-result: every measured result reported as Theory → Measured → Consistent? → Mechanism — prediction before data, noise floor, evidence-tiered mechanism, rule verdict kept apart from direction verdict, plus a debug path for reproducible failures. Five companion agents: blindspot-scout, prototype-smith, ledger-keeper, quiz-master, mechanism-auditor.
